newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia retailers head property investors.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia retailers head property investors.

text.p: The Australian retail area has the largest value of projects under construction in the property sector with A$3.2 billion investment up to mid-September, an economics consultancy said on Thursday.
Access Economics said in its first issue of a quarterly property monitor that the value reflected the expansion of large retail shopping centres.
"Nearly one quarter of projects are under construction and 28 percent were listed as committed," it said.
Under committed projects the highest investment was in major residential developments with A$3.2 billion up to mid September.
But it cautioned a high proportion of committed projects could take a long time to start construction or could be dropped.
There were also a large number of projects in the office, hotel and major residential sectors in planning, despite poor conditions in these sectors due to previous over-building, it said.

"Retail and culture and recreation have well over half of projects listed as definite, reflecting the high level of activity in recent years in the retail areas and the high public sector involvement in culture and recreation and casino projects," it said.
It said recreation had a high proportion of definite projects which reflected the Melbourne's Crown Casino and the Sydney casino projects.
The monitor listed 688 projects worth A$48.4 billion including new investment projects in major residential, office, hotel, retail and recreation sectors.
